title: SG-7.2 · Extend the worker config with work root, budget, auto-publish and provider kind
summary: Worker config gains work_root, max_budget, auto_publish and provider_kind, and validates them
description: Context: backend/worker/internal/config/config.go already loads worker.world_id, repo_path, poll_interval, execution_timeout and max_retries with defaults and env overrides. Desired behavior: add the work root, maximum budget, auto-publish flag and provider kind, and validate these together with the existing timeout and max retries. Expected result: LoadFS returns a fully defaulted, validated Config or a field-naming error. Why: the execution engine needs these controls before it can run supervised, budgeted executions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a YAML with only worker.repo_path, when LoadFS runs, then WorkRoot, MaxBudget, AutoPublish and ProviderKind hold documented defaults
Given an invalid timeout, retries, budget or provider kind, when LoadFS runs, then it returns a nil config and an error naming the field

out_of_scope: Using the new fields in the runner or providers
preserve: Existing defaults for poll_interval, execution_timeout, max_retries, log and store
Existing repo_path validation and env overrides

definition_of_done: Config fields, defaults and validation implemented
Example YAML documents the new keys
